title: Choose the gallery structure
question: The world is set (the envelope, Bebas and Garamond, green-black and bone). This is about how each collection page is organised as rolls and trips pile up. Pick one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Lab folders, one per roll
options.lineage: the photo lab's tabbed sleeve folders
options.thesis: Each roll, and each trip, is a tabbed folder in a stack; the newest sits open on top.
options.viewport: Collection title, then a stack of folder bands with trapezoid tabs; Roll 001 open as a bone sheet showing all 36 frame slots, nine filled.
options.risk: Many folders could stack into a tall wall of tabs; needs a compact closed state once there are 20+ rolls.

raised.raise: Absence is information: the frames Pax did not keep stay as numbered empty slots, so each roll shows its real shape.

options.label: Contact sheets
options.lineage: the lab's contact sheet and proof sheet
options.thesis: Every roll laid out as one contact sheet; a quiet index of rolls runs down the left.
materials: negative strips on a dark sheet
options.viewport: Left column: title, one line, the roll index with the current roll in jade; right: the sheet with strips of six frames.
options.risk: Frames are small on the sheet; the lightbox carries all the size.

options.label: The light table
options.lineage: a photographer's light table, prints scattered by roll
options.thesis: One wide bone field you drag around; each roll and trip lies as its own loose cluster of prints.
options.viewport: Frames of Roll 001 clustered top-left at mixed sizes, Roll 002's place waiting on the right, the title huge at bottom-left.
options.risk: Free panning is the least familiar on a phone and the hardest to make accessible; needs a plain list fallback.

options.label: Collector album
options.lineage: sticker album spreads with ghosted slots
options.thesis: A fixed set of numbered slots; filled ones glossy, missing ones ghosted.
options.viewport: A spread of numbered slots per roll.
options.case: Its slot logic fits rolls exactly, but glossy stickers fight the lab world; it loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Reads as a game rather than an archive.
options.kept: Numbered empty slots for frames not kept, now in the folders card.

options.label: Ticket wallet
options.thesis: Each trip as a coupon book of legs.
options.viewport: A coupon per trip with its route.
options.case: Trips map to legs, but rolls do not; it splits the two collections into different worlds.
options.risk: A second artefact competing with the envelope.
options.kept: One trip per sheet, in sequence, for the mirrorless page.
